snippet.title: Resonant Blade - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at Resonant Blade in this announcement trailer for the upcoming sci-fi action-adventure game inspired by Hyper Light Drifter and Zelda. Prepare to harmonize and form new frequencies to solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and explore the remnants of civilization amidst the shadow of the Synth Uprising. Resonant Blade will be available on Steam in 2025.
